body:
SPEC §46 and the loam_federate_drop tool (T188) promise: an agent STAGES a channel sever and hands the operator a confirm link; a person completes it on the admin container page. The link dead-ends today. The MCP handler's comment assumes a channel's pool is an inbox container the page already reaches, but channel pools live in gw.channelPools (a Map the Gateway keeps beside connectionInboxes, same shape), and planDrop in src/server/admin.ts consults connectionInboxes only. For a channel name the plan resolves to a 409 refusal ('held open by the program that attached it — drop it where it was opened'), so the only sever a person can complete is the CLI's. Found by an independent reader of the federation sections, 2026-09-01; confirmed at admin.ts:828.

The repair (a repair, not a promise change — the promise is §46's and T188's): planDrop gains a third act for a name held in gw.channelPools, and the confirm performer runs gw.dropChannel(name) — the same byte-verified sever the CLI's `loam federate drop` runs, which refuses rather than reporting a purge it cannot prove and takes the channel's blessed law down with its pool. The confirm page's count reads the channel pool's members. The MCP handler's comment states the truth.

Acceptance criteria:
- (a) Two-sided sever through the page: with two live channels (friends:alice, work:carol), the admin drop confirm flow for channel:friends:alice completes (200), channelStatus no longer lists it, its pool's deltas are gone at the bytes, AND channel:work:carol still serves with its deltas present. Verify: test/server/admin-channel-drop.test.ts.
- (b) The confirm page for a channel name renders (200) with the pool's member count, where today it is a 409 refusal. Verify: the same suite, proven red against the unfixed tree.
- (c) The staged link the MCP tool hands back resolves to that page: loam_federate_drop's confirmAt, followed with a session, reaches the confirm page for the same channel. Verify: the same suite.
- (d) A drop the store cannot prove still refuses on the page rather than reporting a purge: a channel whose pool is not attached in this process answers a refusal and nothing is removed. Verify: the same suite.
title: The staged channel sever completes in the browser: planDrop reaches channel pools
